hooks.command: MSG=$(jq -r '.message // ""'); case "$MSG" in *"waiting for your input"*) exit 0 ;; esac; TAB=$(tmux display-message -p -t "${TMUX_PANE:-}" '#W' 2>/dev/null || echo 'no tmux'); osascript -e "display notification \"$TAB — $MSG\" with title \"Claude Code\" subtitle \"awaiting input\" sound name \"Glass\"" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; PTY=$(tmux display-message -p -t "${TMUX_PANE:-}" '#{pane_tty}' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$PTY" ] && printf '\a' > "$PTY" 2>/dev/null || true

TAB=$(tmux display-message -p -t "${TMUX_PANE:-}" '#W' 2>/dev/null || echo 'no tmux'); osascript -e "display notification \"$TAB\" with title \"Claude Code\" subtitle \"finished\" sound name \"Glass\"" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; PTY=$(tmux display-message -p -t "${TMUX_PANE:-}" '#{pane_tty}' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$PTY" ] && printf '\a' > "$PTY" 2>/dev/null || true
